::: {#rem-local-decoding}
#### Reading two symbols instead of the whole word

When $\errfrac \le 1/6$, the success [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1 - 2\errfrac$
in @thm-hadamard-local-decoding is at least $2/3$,
so the [Hadamard code](#def-hadamard-code) is [locally decodable](#def-locally-decodable) with 2 queries,
however long the message is.
When $\errfrac < 1/4$, the decoder is right with probability above $1/2$,
and repeating it with fresh [random choices](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-random-choice) and taking a majority vote
drives its chance of a wrong answer as low as needed.
Decoding to the nearest codeword, as in @thm-distance-corrects-errors,
instead reads the whole received word.
The Hadamard code pays for local decoding with [block length](#def-block-code) $2^k$;
[polynomial](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-polynomial) codes in several variables,
which extend [Reed--Solomon codes](#def-reed-solomon-code),
trade a few more queries for much shorter codewords
[@arora2009computational, chapter 19].

:::
